# package server

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec101/server"
```

Package server is the controlled station of IEC 60870-5-101: it answers the link procedures of the controlling station, hands control-direction ASDUs to a [Handler](#type-handler) and transmits monitor-direction ASDUs: as class 1 or class 2 data when polled (unbalanced transmission), or on its own initiative (balanced transmission).

After the controlling station resets the link for the first time (and after each reset of user process) the server sends end of initialization (M\_EI\_NA\_1, the station initialization procedure of IEC 60870-5-5) unless Config.NoEndOfInit is set.

### type Config

```go
type Config struct {
	iec101.Params

	// LinkAddr is this station's link address.
	LinkAddr uint16
	// Remote is the controlling station's link address in balanced mode.
	Remote uint16
	// CommonAddr is the station's common address, carried by the end of
	// initialization.
	CommonAddr asdu.CommonAddr

	// Handler handles control-direction ASDUs. Nil rejects every request
	// with cause "unknown type identification".
	Handler Handler

	// QueueSize bounds each of the class 1 and class 2 queues (and the
	// balanced send queue). Zero means [DefaultQueueSize]. Send returns
	// [ErrQueueFull] when a queue is full.
	QueueSize int
	// RetryInterval is the pause before a balanced station initializes its
	// direction of the link again. Zero means [DefaultRetryInterval].
	RetryInterval time.Duration

	// NoEndOfInit suppresses end of initialization after the first reset
	// of the link.
	NoEndOfInit bool
	// InitCause is the cause of initialization (COI) of that end of
	// initialization: [asdu.InitLocalPowerOn] by default.
	InitCause uint8

	// OnState is called with each change of the link state.
	OnState func(s iec101.State, err error)
	// Logger receives the log entries; nil is silent.
	Logger iec60870.Logger
}
```

Config configures a server.

### type Handler

```go
type Handler interface {
	HandleASDU(s *Server, a *asdu.ASDU)
}
```

Handler handles the control-direction ASDUs of the controlling station. Calls are made one at a time from a goroutine of the server; a handler answers through the Server (Confirm, Terminate, Send, ...).

#### func (Server) Send

```go
func (s *Server) Send(a *asdu.ASDU) error
```

Send queues a monitor-direction ASDU: as class 1 data in unbalanced transmission (events, confirmations), or for transmission in balanced transmission.

#### func (Server) SendClass

```go
func (s *Server) SendClass(a *asdu.ASDU, c Class) error
```

SendClass queues a monitor-direction ASDU as class 1 or class 2 data. In balanced transmission the class is ignored.

#### func (Server) State

```go
func (s *Server) State() iec101.State
```

State returns the link state: up once the controlling station reset the link (unbalanced) or both directions are initialized (balanced).
